from copy import deepcopy
from datetime import date
import hashlib
import hmac
import json

import pytest

from trialops.privacy import export_subjects


ON = date(2024, 6, 15)


def make_subject(subject_id="subject-one", **changes):
    record = {
        "id": subject_id,
        "name": "Fictional Person",
        "birth_date": "1990-04-03",
        "email": "person@example.test",
        "country": "NZ",
        "visits": ["2024-05-01", "2024-01-02"],
        "consents": [{"purpose": "research", "signed_on": "2024-06-15"}],
        "purge_after": "2024-06-15",
    }
    record.update(changes)
    return record


def pseudonym(subject_id, *, purpose="research", secret="test-secret"):
    message = f"{purpose}:{subject_id}".encode("utf-8")
    return hmac.new(secret.encode("utf-8"), message, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()[:16]


def canonical(value):
    return json.dumps(
        value,
        sort_keys=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
        ensure_ascii=False,
        allow_nan=False,
    )


def test_active_boundaries_sorting_schema_and_canonical_manifest():
    subjects = [make_subject("subject-b"), make_subject("subject-a")]
    original = deepcopy(subjects)

    result = export_subjects(subjects, purpose="research", secret="test-secret", on=ON)

    expected_rows = [
        {
            "pseudonym": pseudonym("subject-a"),
            "country": "NZ",
            "birth_year": 1990,
            "visits": ["2024-01-02", "2024-05-01"],
        },
        {
            "pseudonym": pseudonym("subject-b"),
            "country": "NZ",
            "birth_year": 1990,
            "visits": ["2024-01-02", "2024-05-01"],

    ]
    expected_rows.sort(key=lambda row: row["pseudonym"])
    assert result["rows"] == expected_rows
    assert result["manifest"] == {
        "algorithm": "sha256",
        "count": 2,
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(canonical(expected_rows).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest(),
    }
    assert subjects == original


def test_withdrawal_on_on_is_inactive_but_later_withdrawal_is_active():

def test_output_is_deterministic_and_scoped_to_purpose_and_secret():
    subjects = [make_subject(f"subject-{index}") for index in range(5)]
    for subject in subjects:
        subject["consents"].append({"purpose": "audit", "signed_on": "2024-01-01"})

    first = export_subjects(subjects, purpose="research", secret="test-secret", on=ON)
    second = export_subjects(subjects, purpose="research", secret="test-secret", on=ON)
    shuffled = export_subjects(
        list(reversed(subjects)), purpose="research", secret="test-secret", on=ON
    )
    lazy = export_subjects(
        (subject for subject in subjects),
        purpose="research",
        secret="test-secret",
        on=ON,
    )
    assert first == second == shuffled == lazy
    assert canonical(first) == canonical(shuffled)
    assert first["rows"] is not second["rows"]

    pseudonyms = [row["pseudonym"] for row in first["rows"]]
    assert pseudonyms == sorted(pseudonyms)
    assert len(set(pseudonyms)) == 5

    other_secret = export_subjects(
        subjects, purpose="research", secret="other-secret", on=ON
    )
    other_purpose = export_subjects(
        subjects, purpose="audit", secret="test-secret", on=ON
    )
    for other in (other_secret, other_purpose):
        assert other["manifest"]["count"] == 5
        assert not set(pseudonyms) & {row["pseudonym"] for row in other["rows"]}
        assert other["manifest"]["sha256"] != first["manifest"]["sha256"]


def test_manifest_hashes_canonical_utf8_json_without_ascii_escaping():
    result = export_subjects(
        [make_subject("subject-a", country="Åland"), make_subject("subject-b")],
        purpose="research",
        secret="test-secret",
        on=ON,
    )

    rows = result["rows"]
    expected = json.dumps(
        rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False
    ).encode("utf-8")
    assert "Åland".encode("utf-8") in expected
    assert b" " not in expected
    assert result["manifest"] == {
        "algorithm": "sha256",
        "count": 2,
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest(),
    }
    escaped = json.dumps(rows, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
    assert result["manifest"]["sha256"] != hashlib.sha256(escaped).hexdigest()
    assert len(rows[0]["pseudonym"]) == 16
    assert set(rows[0]["pseudonym"]) <= set("0123456789abcdef")

from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
import json

import pytest

from trialops import privacy
from trialops.governance import apply_reuse_action
from trialops.privacy import execute_reuse_export, export_subjects


PURPOSE = "synthetic methods research"
SECRET = "integration-secret-value"
NOW = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
EXECUTE_AT = NOW + timedelta(days=1)
DIRECT_IDENTIFIERS = (
    "sensitive-id",
    "Fictional Person",
    "person@example.test",
    "1990-04-03",
    "2030-01-01",
    "purge_after",
    "consents",
    "signed_on",
    SECRET,
)


def make_request(status="draft", **changes):
    value = {
        "id": "reuse-001",
        "requester": "alice",
        "reviewer": "bob",
        "purpose": PURPOSE,
        "status": status,
        "retention_until": "2025-06-30",
        "privacy_plan": {
            "algorithm": "hmac-sha256",
            "domain": PURPOSE,
            "fields": ["pseudonym", "country", "birth_year", "visits"],
        },
        "metadata": {
            "representative": True,
            "complete": True,
            "quality_score": 0.95,
        },
        "history": [],
    }
    value.update(changes)
    return value


def approved_request():
    submitted = apply_reuse_action(make_request(), "submit", "alice", NOW)
    return apply_reuse_action(submitted, "approve", "bob", NOW)


def make_subject(subject_id, **changes):
    record = {
        "id": subject_id,
        "name": "Fictional Person",
        "birth_date": "1990-04-03",
        "email": "person@example.test",
        "country": "NZ",
        "visits": ["2024-05-01", "2024-01-02"],
        "consents": [{"purpose": PURPOSE, "signed_on": "2024-01-01"}],
        "purge_after": "2030-01-01",
    }
    record.update(changes)
    return record


class TrackingSubjects:
    """An iterable that records how often it has been consumed."""

    def __init__(self, records):
        self._records = records
        self.iterations = 0

    def __iter__(self):
        self.iterations += 1
        return iter(self._records)


def assert_no_direct_identifiers(text):
    for identifier in DIRECT_IDENTIFIERS:
        assert identifier not in text


def test_end_to_end_execution_stores_the_unchanged_export():
    approved = approved_request()
    approved_snapshot = deepcopy(approved)
    records = [
        make_subject("sensitive-id-1"),
        make_subject("sensitive-id-2", country="AU"),
        make_subject(
            "sensitive-id-3",
            consents=[{"purpose": "another purpose", "signed_on": "2024-01-01"}],
        ),
    ]
    records_snapshot = deepcopy(records)
    subjects = TrackingSubjects(records)

    executed = execute_reuse_export(
        approved, subjects, actor="alice", secret=SECRET, now=EXECUTE_AT
    )

    expected_export = export_subjects(
        records, purpose=PURPOSE, secret=SECRET, on=date(2025, 1, 2)
    )
    assert expected_export["manifest"]["count"] == 2
    assert executed["execution_result"] == expected_export
    assert executed["status"] == "executed"
    assert [entry["action"] for entry in executed["history"]] == [
        "submit",
        "approve",
        "execute",
    ]
    assert executed["history"][-1] == {
        "action": "execute",
        "actor": "alice",
        "at": "2025-01-02T12:00:00Z",
    }
    # Everything except the outcome of execution is carried over unchanged.
    remainder = {
        key: value
        for key, value in executed.items()
        if key not in ("status", "execution_result", "history")
    }
    assert remainder == {
        key: value
        for key, value in approved_snapshot.items()
        if key not in ("status", "history")
    }
    assert executed["history"][:-1] == approved_snapshot["history"]

    assert subjects.iterations == 1
    assert approved == approved_snapshot
    assert records == records_snapshot
    assert executed is not approved
    assert_no_direct_identifiers(json.dumps(executed, ensure_ascii=False))
    assert_no_direct_identifiers(repr(executed))


def test_delegates_once_to_governance_and_once_to_the_export(monkeypatch):
    approved = approved_request()
    records = [make_subject("sensitive-id-1")]
    governance_calls = []
    export_calls = []
    real_apply = privacy.apply_reuse_action
    real_export = privacy.export_subjects

    def apply_spy(*args, **kwargs):
        governance_calls.append((args, kwargs))
        return real_apply(*args, **kwargs)

    def export_spy(*args, **kwargs):
        export_calls.append((args, kwargs))
        return real_export(*args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(privacy, "apply_reuse_action", apply_spy)
    monkeypatch.setattr(privacy, "export_subjects", export_spy)

    executed = execute_reuse_export(
        approved, records, actor="alice", secret=SECRET, now=EXECUTE_AT
    )

    assert len(governance_calls) == 1
    args, kwargs = governance_calls[0]
    assert args == (approved, "execute", "alice", EXECUTE_AT)
    assert args[0] is approved
    assert set(kwargs) == {"executor"}
    assert callable(kwargs["executor"])

    assert len(export_calls) == 1
    args, kwargs = export_calls[0]
    assert args == (records,)
    assert args[0] is records
    assert kwargs == {"purpose": PURPOSE, "secret": SECRET, "on": date(2025, 1, 2)}
    assert executed["execution_result"] == real_export(
        records, purpose=PURPOSE, secret=SECRET, on=date(2025, 1, 2)
    )


def test_export_uses_the_utc_date_of_now():
    # 22:00 on 1 January at UTC-5 is 03:00 on 2 January in UTC.
    local_now = datetime(2025, 1, 1, 22, 0, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=-5)))
    active_only_on_local_date = make_subject("sensitive-id-1")
    active_only_on_local_date["consents"][0]["withdrawn_on"] = "2025-01-02"
    active_only_on_utc_date = make_subject("sensitive-id-2")
    active_only_on_utc_date["consents"][0]["signed_on"] = "2025-01-02"
    records = [active_only_on_local_date, active_only_on_utc_date]

    executed = execute_reuse_export(
        approved_request(), records, actor="alice", secret=SECRET, now=local_now
    )

    utc_export = export_subjects(
        records, purpose=PURPOSE, secret=SECRET, on=date(2025, 1, 2)
    )
    local_export = export_subjects(
        records, purpose=PURPOSE, secret=SECRET, on=date(2025, 1, 1)
    )
    assert utc_export["manifest"]["count"] == 1
    assert utc_export != local_export
    assert executed["execution_result"] == utc_export
    assert executed["history"][-1]["at"] == "2025-01-02T03:00:00Z"


def test_export_purpose_comes_from_the_approved_request():
    purpose = "another approved purpose"
    request = make_request(purpose=purpose)
    request["privacy_plan"]["domain"] = purpose
    submitted = apply_reuse_action(request, "submit", "alice", NOW)
    approved = apply_reuse_action(submitted, "approve", "bob", NOW)
    records = [

    expected = export_subjects(

    assert expected["manifest"]["count"] == 1
    assert executed["execution_result"] == expected
    assert executed["execution_result"] != export_subjects(
        records, purpose=PURPOSE, secret=SECRET, on=date(2025, 1, 2)

def test_export_failure_rolls_back_to_the_approved_request(records, secret):
    approved = approved_request()
    snapshot = deepcopy(approved)
    records_snapshot = deepcopy(records)

    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as caught:
        execute_reuse_export(
            approved, records, actor="alice", secret=secret, now=EXECUTE_AT
        )

    assert str(caught.value) == "EXECUTION_FAILED"
    assert_no_direct_identifiers(str(caught.value))
    assert isinstance(caught.value.__cause__, ValueError)
    assert_no_direct_identifiers(str(caught.value.__cause__))
    assert approved == snapshot
    assert approved["status"] == "approved"
    assert "execution_result" not in approved
    assert [entry["action"] for entry in approved["history"]] == ["submit", "approve"]
    assert records == records_snapshot

    # The untouched approved request is still executable once the data is fixed.
    retried = execute_reuse_export(
        approved,
        [make_subject("sensitive-id-1")],
        actor="alice",
        secret=SECRET,
        now=EXECUTE_AT,
    )
    assert retried["status"] == "executed"
    assert retried["execution_result"]["manifest"]["count"] == 1
    assert [entry["action"] for entry in retried["history"]] == [
        "submit",
        "approve",
        "execute",

def test_repeated_execution_is_rejected_without_reconsuming_subjects():
    subjects = TrackingSubjects([make_subject("sensitive-id-1")])
    executed = execute_reuse_export(
        approved_request(), subjects, actor="alice", secret=SECRET, now=EXECUTE_AT
    )
    snapshot = deepcopy(executed)
    assert subjects.iterations == 1

    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as caught:
        execute_reuse_export(
            executed,
            subjects,
            actor="alice",
            secret=SECRET,
            now=EXECUTE_AT + timedelta(hours=1),
        )

    assert str(caught.value) == "INVALID_STATE"
    assert subjects.iterations == 1
    assert executed == snapshot
    assert len(executed["history"]) == 3


def test_returned_export_is_independent_of_inputs_and_empty_input_is_valid():
